model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the average performance of models with varying parameter counts on closed-book factual sentence completion benchmarks. The x-axis represents the model size on a logarithmic scale, ranging from 70m to 7.0B, with tick labels at 70m, 160m, 410m, 1.0B, 1.4B, 2.8B, and 7.0B. The y-axis represents the average performance as a percentage, with a scale from 0 to 80%, labeled in increments of 20. The plot features three lines: a red line representing precision, a blue line representing recall, and a purple line representing the F1-score. The red line starts at approximately 78% at 70m and decreases to around 77% at 7.0B, with a relatively steady trend. The blue line starts at around 10% at 70m and increases to approximately 45% at 7.0B, showing a steady upward trend. The purple line starts at about 15% at 70m and increases to around 55% at 7.0B, also exhibiting a steady upward trend.
